quote: I walked in one Sunday knowing nobody in this city. By the end of the month I had a church family, a small group and three people praying for my job search.
name: Adaeze — member since 2023

quote: The prayer line answered at two in the morning. Somebody prayed with me until I could breathe again. I will never forget that night.
name: Michael — Exeter

quote: Our children ask on Saturday whether tomorrow is church day. That tells you everything about what the children's team have built.
name: The Bamgbose family

quote: I came for the music and stayed for the word. Eighteen months later I was baptised in that same building.
name: Hannah — university student
